name: QUANTUM-GATE STUDIO
subtitle: Multi-Qubit Circuit Simulator & Quantum Algorithm Visualizer

quantumEngines.stateVector: Complex state vector algebra (C^(2^n)) with exact linear transformations
quantumEngines.gateLibrary: Single-qubit (H, X, Y, Z, S, T, Tdg, Rx, Ry, Rz), Two-qubit (CNOT, CZ, CP, SWAP), Three-qubit (Toffoli, CSWAP), Projective Measurement
quantumEngines.blochSphere: 3D spherical coordinates (theta, phi), basis poles (|0>, |1>, |+>, |->, |i>, |-i>), mixed-state entanglement vector shrinkage
quantumEngines.densityMatrix: Full state density matrix rho = |psi><psi| and partial trace Tr_~q(rho) for single-qubit reduced states
quantumEngines.entanglementEntropy: Von Neumann entropy S(rho) = -Tr(rho log2 rho) measurement

interactiveSystems.circuitComposer: Interactive multi-qubit grid with drag-and-drop / click gate placement, control connectors, and step timeline playhead
interactiveSystems.curatedAlgorithms: Bell State (|Phi+>), Quantum Teleportation, Grover Search, 3-Qubit QFT, Deutsch-Jozsa, Superdense Coding
interactiveSystems.sonification: 100% procedural Web Audio quantum superposition phase interference sonification, collapse bursts, and entanglement drone
interactiveSystems.openQasmInterchange: OpenQASM 2.0 code generation, syntax parser, and SVG schematic export
